script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local Black = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
local Lime  = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)

local FontBold = Enum.Font.ArialBold

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "MathewTheScripter_ClientExec"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.Parent = PlayerGui

local ToggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
ToggleBtn.Name = "ToggleBtn"
ToggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 40)
ToggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Black
ToggleBtn.BorderSizePixel = 3
ToggleBtn.BorderColor3 = Lime
ToggleBtn.Text = "Open"
ToggleBtn.TextColor3 = Lime
ToggleBtn.Font = FontBold
ToggleBtn.TextScaled = true
ToggleBtn.Parent = ScreenGui

local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 450, 0, 350)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 170, 0, 10)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Black
MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 3
MainFrame.BorderColor3 = Lime
MainFrame.Active = true
MainFrame.Draggable = true
MainFrame.Visible = false
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
Title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
Title.BackgroundColor3 = Black
Title.BorderSizePixel = 3
Title.BorderColor3 = Lime
Title.Text = "MathewTheScripter"
Title.TextColor3 = Lime
Title.Font = FontBold
Title.TextScaled = true
Title.Parent = MainFrame

local CodeScroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
CodeScroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 220)
CodeScroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 46)
CodeScroll.BackgroundColor3 = Black
CodeScroll.BorderSizePixel = 3
CodeScroll.BorderColor3 = Lime
CodeScroll.ScrollBarThickness = 8
CodeScroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 600)
CodeScroll.Parent = MainFrame

local CodeBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
CodeBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -10)
CodeBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 5)
CodeBox.BackgroundTransparency = 1
CodeBox.PlaceholderText = "Write Script Here"
CodeBox.PlaceholderColor3 = Lime
CodeBox.Text = ""
CodeBox.TextColor3 = Lime
CodeBox.Font = FontBold
CodeBox.TextSize = 14
CodeBox.MultiLine = true
CodeBox.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
CodeBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
CodeBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
CodeBox.Parent = CodeScroll

local ExecBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
ExecBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.48, -3, 0, 60)
ExecBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, -67)
ExecBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Black
ExecBtn.BorderSizePixel = 3
ExecBtn.BorderColor3 = Lime
ExecBtn.Text = "Execute"
ExecBtn.TextColor3 = Lime
ExecBtn.Font = FontBold
ExecBtn.TextScaled = true
ExecBtn.Parent = MainFrame

local ClearBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
ClearBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.48, 0, 0, 60)
ClearBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.52, 0, 1, -67)
ClearBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Black
ClearBtn.BorderSizePixel = 3
ClearBtn.BorderColor3 = Lime
ClearBtn.Text = "Clear"
ClearBtn.TextColor3 = Lime
ClearBtn.Font = FontBold
ClearBtn.TextScaled = true
ClearBtn.Parent = MainFrame

local SidePanel = Instance.new("Frame")
SidePanel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 1, 0)
SidePanel.Position = UDim2.new(1, 5, 0, 0)
SidePanel.BackgroundColor3 = Black
SidePanel.BorderSizePixel = 3
SidePanel.BorderColor3 = Lime
SidePanel.Visible = false
SidePanel.Parent = MainFrame

local ArrowBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
ArrowBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
ArrowBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ArrowBtn.Text = "←"
ArrowBtn.TextColor3 = Lime
ArrowBtn.Font = FontBold
ArrowBtn.TextScaled = true
ArrowBtn.Parent = SidePanel

local ScriptsFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
ScriptsFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 1, 0)
ScriptsFrame.Position = UDim2.new(1, 3, 0, 0)
ScriptsFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Black
ScriptsFrame.BorderSizePixel = 3
ScriptsFrame.BorderColor3 = Lime
ScriptsFrame.Visible = false
ScriptsFrame.Parent = SidePanel

local scriptsList = {
    {name = "1. Fly GUI", code = 'loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://pastebin.com/raw/9kTfJ9W2"))()'},
    {name = "2. Fling", code = 'loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-Touch-fling-script-22447"))()'},
    {name = "3. Invisible", code = 'loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://pastebin.com/raw/vP6CrQJj"))()'},
    {name = "4. Admin", code = 'loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-Nameless-admin-reworked-75477"))()'},
    {name = "5. Ghost", code = 'loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Danster206/Ghost-Hub-Danster206-/refs/heads/main/Ghost%20Hub.lua"))()'},
    {name = "6. Troll", code = 'loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://pastefy.app/rmdi1m55/raw"))()'},
    {name = "7. Emotes", code = 'loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://scriptblox.com/raw/Brookhaven-RP-all-emotes-6849"))()'},
    {name = "8. Roblox Egor", code = 'loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GithubMagical/Roblox-Egor/refs/heads/main/lua%20v2", true))()'}
}

local column1 = {}
local column2 = {}

for i, scriptData in ipairs(scriptsList) do
    if i <= 4 then
        table.insert(column1, scriptData)
    else
        table.insert(column2, scriptData)
    end
end

local yOffset1 = 20
for i, scriptData in ipairs(column1) do
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.43, 0, 0, 40)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0, yOffset1)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Black
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 3
    btn.BorderColor3 = Lime
    btn.Text = scriptData.name
    btn.TextColor3 = Lime
    btn.Font = FontBold
    btn.TextScaled = true
    btn.Parent = ScriptsFrame
    
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local success, err = pcall(function()
            loadstring(scriptData.code)()
        end)
        if not success then
            warn("Ошибка в " .. scriptData.name .. ": " .. tostring(err))
        end
    end)
    
    yOffset1 = yOffset1 + 90
end

local yOffset2 = 20
for i, scriptData in ipairs(column2) do
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.43, 0, 0, 40)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.54, 0, 0, yOffset2)  
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Black
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 3
    btn.BorderColor3 = Lime
    btn.Text = scriptData.name
    btn.TextColor3 = Lime
    btn.Font = FontBold
    btn.TextScaled = true
    btn.Parent = ScriptsFrame
    
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local success, err = pcall(function()
            loadstring(scriptData.code)()
        end)
        if not success then
            warn("Ошибка в " .. scriptData.name .. ": " .. tostring(err))
        end
    end)
    
    yOffset2 = yOffset2 + 90
end

local PanelOpen = false

ToggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    PanelOpen = not PanelOpen
    MainFrame.Visible = PanelOpen
    SidePanel.Visible = PanelOpen
    ScriptsFrame.Visible = false
    ArrowBtn.Text = "←"
    ToggleBtn.Text = PanelOpen and "Close" or "Open"
end)

ArrowBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    ScriptsFrame.Visible = not ScriptsFrame.Visible
    ArrowBtn.Text = ScriptsFrame.Visible and "→" or "←"
end)

local function executeCode()
    local code = CodeBox.Text
    if code == "" or code:match("^%s*$") then return end
    
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        loadstring(code)()
    end)
    
    if not success then
        warn("Executor error: " .. tostring(err))
    end
end

ExecBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(executeCode)
ClearBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() CodeBox.Text = "" end)
CodeBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter) if enter then executeCode() end end)
